title: Sunny
tagline: Sunny is a candy-crush crypto crash game where the user will match tiles to get a high score
description: Sunny is a decentralized candy-crush crypto crash game where the user will match tiles to get a high score. Match tiles in 3 or more to crush them and improve your score. Matching combinations can be from up,down, left and right. Sunny is built using Lighthouse CLI, IPFS and React
how_its_made: Sunny uses IPFS and Lighthouse. We use the lighthouse cli to deploy to IPFS via the Polygon Mumbai network. Sunny is made using React, html, css and Javascript. I want Sunny to be more than one game, make it more of a mini-game and plan to add more more games to it in the near future
